Protein Food

Monkfish Tail

About This Entry

Monkfish tail is dense, sweet muscle — braised or roasted in French and coastal cuisines. Full-bodied whites and medium reds with acid suit saffron and tomato broth.

Beginner Guide

Only the tail is commonly sold; head is often used for stock.

FAQ

What is Monkfish Tail?
Only the tail is commonly sold; head is often used for stock.
How should Monkfish Tail be cooked for best results?
Do not overcook lean fillets; shellfish should be opaque and firm. Rest fish briefly before serving.
